title: Pre-flight asserts the gateway is on postpaid Workers AI billing
description: AI Gateway has a per-gateway workers_ai_billing_mode. On postpaid, Workers AI lands on the normal Cloudflare invoice, where an account credit can absorb it. On unified, the same traffic drains a separately purchased prepaid wallet (bought at a 5 percent premium) instead — so a one-click dashboard change silently moves every run from credit-funded to cash-funded, with no signal in our telemetry. Pre-flight should read the gateway config and fail loudly if the mode is not the one the operator configured.
notes: 2026-08-21 16:55 - Seam (wave 2, six wide). You own pre-flight — internal/factory and whatever reads the gateway's config. fxf owns gateway.ts request headers; stay out of the proxy path. Measured context: both of this operator's gateways currently report workers_ai_billing_mode=postpaid, which is the mode that reaches the invoice where the credit lives; unified would silently move spend to a separately purchased prepaid wallet at a 5 percent premium. repo-wiki/cloud-factory-billing.md has the three-pot model.
